faqs.q: Can it update a row instead of adding a new one each time?
faqs.a: Yes. “Lookup Spreadsheet Rows” finds the row that matches a value, such as an order number, and “Update Spreadsheet Row” changes its columns, so the same record is not added twice.

faqs.q: Can a change in my sheet start something?
faqs.a: Yes. “Row Added Or Updated” starts an automation or an AI agent when someone adds or edits a row, for example to post the new row in Slack or email the person named in it.

faqs.q: Can I turn my spreadsheet into an app?
faqs.a: Yes. Ask Captain for the app you need, then bring your rows in by pasting the table or dropping in a CSV or Excel export. Captain matches the columns to the app’s fields before anything is added.

faqs.q: Can it write several rows in one go?
faqs.a: Yes. “Add Multiple Rows” writes many rows in one step, which suits one row per order item. Say so in the ask and check Captain’s plan before you approve it.
